provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code on the ring x^231 - 1 with a(x) = x^18 + x^30 + x^32 + x^47 + x^52 + x^63 + x^70 + x^99 + x^163 + x^177 + x^189 + x^203 + x^204, b(x) = x^1 + x^7 + x^10 + x^71 + x^81 + x^118 + x^163 + x^176 + x^204 + x^212 + x^222; H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)], H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T].
provenance.notes: Found by a randomized sweep over sparse polynomial pairs, screened against the live board before any expensive work. Checked for single-block logicals via the ideal generated by (x^m - 1)/gcd(a, x^m - 1) before the distance was believed.
